shortIntro.title: Is Your Phone Ready for Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile? 🎮📱
shortIntro.para1: Warzone Mobile is a fast-paced battle royale with intense gunfights, tactical movement, and squad-based gameplay. Even minor lag can cost you a win.
shortIntro.para2: Smooth aiming, responsive controls, and instant reloads all depend on your device performance. If your phone struggles, you’ll spend more time spectating than winning 😅🔥.

intro: Here are the updated minimum and recommended device requirements for running Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile smoothly on Android and iOS — whether you’re grinding ranked matches or enjoying casual squad battles 😎.

faqIntroText: Common Warzone Mobile questions — answered clearly 😎:

faqList.question: Does Warzone Mobile require a high-end phone?
faqList.answer: Yes, mid-range or better devices provide smoother FPS, responsive controls, and better aiming.

faqList.question: Is 60 FPS possible on mobile?
faqList.answer: Yes, on capable mid-range and flagship phones with max FPS mode enabled.

faqList.question: Why does Warzone Mobile heat my phone?
faqList.answer: Continuous action, detailed maps, and high graphics push CPU and GPU hard. Proper cooling and breaks help 😅.
